lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are organized in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The arrangement exhibits a staggered distribution with the highest intensity local maxima concentrated in the mid-lateral flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, forming a coarse, rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the mid-flank region posterior to the gills.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and a shadowed lower edge, tracking parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) are visible clustered along the ventral margin and beneath the primary pectoral fin.
